en: It's creepy how he grins every so often, even with nobody around.{w}

"We found the Lightstair Ruins, y'know!{w}The site of the Stairway of Light -- the one you lot loudly swore
'could never be found'!"{w}
'That's Chief Barjeff.{w}The ruler of Teridon, and a fabulously rich tycoon.{w}One with a bit of a troublesome habit, though...'{w}

"Now, now, Rianna, you're next!{w}Today, at long last,
let us share a hug, shall weeeee!!"{w}
"...Just try laying a single finger on me.{w}I will shoot you clean through with the magic gun that sleeps in my arm."{w}

'And last but not least, this distinguished figure.{w}The ruler of Lumisthenes --
our very own Council Chair Wattner~!'{w}
"We'll build a great big cannon!{w}Let's do it big and flashy -- 'KA-BOOOOOM!!'"{w}

"...They could probably build that cannon."{w}{p}"The technology of ogres and goblins
holds a great deal of ancient wisdom that has otherwise been lost.{w}It is not to be taken lightly."{w}
"Y-yeah, that's right, I was totally awake, good morning!{w}Welcome to the temple of entertainment, MILL.GP...{w}Huh? Star Capital Double-Up...?"{w}

"Your cards are...{w}first, the {0C:0003:0013} of {0C:0001:000E},
second, the {0C:0003:0014} of {0C:0001:000F}!?"{w}{p}"My word...!!{w}You have a blackjack!
A clean win for you!!"{w}{p}"Congratulations!
A 5x bonus payout! 2500 GP!
Please, take your winnings."{w}

"Your cards are...{w}first, the {0C:0003:0013} of {0C:0001:000E},
second, the {0C:0003:0014} of {0C:0001:000F}!?"{w}{p}"However, my cards are...{w}first, the {0C:0003:0016} of {0C:0001:0011},
second, the {0C:0003:0017} of {0C:0001:0012}!!!"{w}{p}"I have blackjack!{w}I'm afraid you lose."{w}{p}"That's skill for you.{w}I'll be taking your bet,
but please don't hold it against me."{w}

"Sorry about this -- I have 21,
which means you lose."{w}{p}"Well, that's skill for you.{w}My apologies, but I'll be taking your bet."{w}
